label: D1 is fixed: the Webflow checker collects deferred callback errors from setTimeout and requestAnimationFrame through a run_callback wrapper and reports the first source and message, so a script whose deferred code throws now fails. VERIFIED CLOSURE.

D3 is fixed: the playbook index row points at the stack-folder validator scenario and the expected language list names all six folders (config, javascript, python, rust, shell, typescript). VERIFIED CLOSURE.

D4 is fixed: the shared stdin reader has a 3000 ms deadline that settles on stream end or deadline and clears timer and listeners, and both post-edit adapters import it instead of carrying their own copy. VERIFIED CLOSURE.

The precedence and Obsidian recommendation is closed across the surfaces: OBSIDIAN row and OPENCODE > OBSIDIAN > WEBFLOW > UNKNOWN in stack-detection, hub surface table and order, ROUTER.md vocabulary, playbook SD-004 with a dedicated scenario, both canary cases, and the advisor graph. VERIFIED CLOSURE.

The D1 fix still lacks its known-bad test input: the checker carries the deferred-error handling, but no companion test or fixture feeds a throwing deferred callback, so round one's recommendation 2 is half closed. NEW residual.

The retirement-note recommendation is not closed: the successor exists as .github/workflows/routing-registry-drift.yml, but no in-repo retirement note was located and the only references to the retired router-sync guard live in old spec records. OPEN.
